correctness.rationale: For all integers r>=0, digitwise 3b_j+c_j=y_j+2c_(j+1) with c∈{0,1,2} and terminal digit parity tau(c_r) yields C_r=e M^r v, where M=[[1,1,0],[-1,0,-1],[0,1,1]], e=[1,0,0], v=[1,-1,-1]. Exact resolvent is (1-2z+3z²)/((1-z)(1-z+2z²)); eigenvalues 1,(1±i√7)/2 give C_r=1-(2/√7)Im(((1+i√7)/2)^r), correct for r=0,1,2. Marginal N-matrix yields U_r with classical 3^(r/2) scale, and the four joint parity cells (2^r+bU_r+abC_r)/4 for r>=1. Irrationality of eigenangle follows from 1/√2 not an algebraic integer, giving infinite positive/negative subsequences of 2^(r/2). Independent symbolic resolvent and direct bit-popcount enumeration through r=13 agreed. Infinite oscillation follows analytic density not finite sample.
